name: prompt-polish
description: Personal fork of oh-my-fable 2.7.4 (Junhan2, MIT). Same always-on working rules and skills, plus a model-specific layer: the hook detects the session model (SessionStart model field, PostModelSwitch) and adds the matching rules from Anthropic's prompting guide for Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Opus 5, or Sonnet 5 (Fable 5.1 needs none: its guide's prompts are all in the base rules). tests/guide-verbatim.sh checks every model rule against the live guides. Skills are named guide-* (guide-rewrite, guide-audit, guide-setup, guide-status); guide-rewrite also follows OpenAI's GPT-6 and Codex guides when run in Codex.

card.title: Improved request card
card.description: Draw the improved request that /guide-rewrite prints as a card in the transcript (terminal Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, and the desktop app). Turn off to keep the plain code block.
